title: Current optimized live PromQL API baseline
internal_checks: Explicitly enabled in both C and C++; this is a qualification build.

compiled_source_proof.scope: Frozen repository and existing ACLK-schema inputs match their actual immutable Git blobs. Generated/configured artifacts and installed toolchains retain separate build bindings; Python integration changes are not compiled inputs.

plan.scope: Eight finite diagnostic queries, not repeated performance samples or new original conformance. Exact expression; simplified labels and one-point histories differ from live Netdata.

generic_histogram_diagnostic.scope: Same exact live histogram expression plus nested-union/direct-classic/direct-gauge controls. Simplified two-series/one-point input, pages1/1024; single execution times are diagnostic, not qualified speed ratios.

retained_failures.meaning: Old HTTP launch omits explicit private runtime settings; interception prevents creating an Agent.
New caller incorrectly expected top-level stats; correct actual data.stats response is retained. The Agent passes29HTTP/12readiness checks and exits0.
Actual-envelope regression fails on that same caller parsing mistake without a process or HTTP request.

old_measurement_caller.reason: Caller wrongly expected top-level stats; actual C output and retained complete scalar response use data.stats.
old_measurement_caller.scope: Test caller parsing correction only. No product source, original expectation or build changes.

historical_source_disposition.early_static_receipts: Retained locally as superseded checkpoints; final corrected caller checks and actual measurements are the qualification here.

limits: Tiny fixed-clock two-host data fits configured DBengine caches; warm API evidence only.
Client request overlap does not establish simultaneous Rust evaluators.
RSS is the whole Agent; high-water includes startup and earlier qualification.
Wire duration includes connection establishment, server work and final body delivery; excludes client decoding/validation.
HTTP sample counts are logical and do not count fetched pages or allocated bytes.
Shared host; no CPU/frequency isolation, cold-disk, high-cardinality, IoT or physical ARM performance claim.
RSS excludes kernel file-cache memory and temporary-file size; this does not establish total system query footprint.
Server timing snapshots precede final C output commit; they omit its completed JSON assembly/compression.
The eight generic diagnostic cases use simplified labels and one-point histories. Single elapsed samples are not a qualified live-versus-generic speed ratio or attribution of C/provider cost.
All new code is caller/test/documentation code; the compiled production engine/provider/storage/API and numerical reference remain unchanged.
The continuous performance/coverage/memory objective remains active; repeated generic nested-union/classic-histogram evaluation is a measured next lead.
